goal: Launch the test store with 100 Founding Testers, and Zuri live on 19 Oct

steps.t: Paste the new Daraja HQ script (v1.4)
steps.why: So every tester’s report lands right here in Daraja HQ.
how: Say “copy the script” to Claude.
script.google.com → the HQ project → click in the code → Cmd+A → Cmd+V → Cmd+S.
Deploy → Manage deployments → ✏️ → New version → Deploy.

steps.t: Dress rehearsal: every device plays a stranger
steps.why: Find what breaks before real people do.
how: Print the Dress Rehearsal Kit (Store → Founding Testers).
Each device: private window, follow its card.
Watch it all arrive here in Daraja HQ.
Tell Claude “here’s what we found”.

steps.t: Run each app once, start to finish
steps.where: Phone or iPad · about an hour
steps.why: You wanted to see every app run once before we launch.
how: Open Test Day: it walks the apps one at a time.
Each app: watch the tour, use it for a minute, tick ✓.
Anything odd: tap ? → Help, or tell Claude.

steps.why: Claude puts a Founding Testers banner on the store and checks every link. The store stays in test mode, so nothing is for sale yet.
how: Say “launch the test store”.
Open the store and check the banner.

steps.why: The people who know you sign up first.
how: Open the Marketing Kit and copy the text message.
Send it to 20 people, one at a time or as a group.
Copy the Facebook post from the Marketing Kit.
Post it with the link.

steps.why: The people these apps were made for.
how: Give the bulletin blurb to the office.
Print 5 flyers (last page of the Marketing Kit) and put them on the welcome table.
Ask the pastor for a 30-second mention.

steps.t: Set up the iPad before you leave (Wednesday night)
steps.why: For two weeks the Mac at home does the work and the iPad is your window.
how: Say “give me the HQ link”, open it on the iPad, Add to Home Screen.
Say “keep the Mac awake for my trip”.
From the iPad, send one message to this chat.

steps.t: While you’re away: five minutes a day
steps.why: Testers hear back the same day; nothing piles up.
how: Open Daraja HQ → Today.
Say “check the testers” and “work the stack” in the Claude chat.
Approve the drafts, then tick ✓ here when the day is done.
